Class IAuraGraphicsAdapter

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Aura
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Represents a physical or virtual graphics adapter (GPU) available on the system. Provides access to adapter properties such as memory sizes, hardware identifiers, and supported API versions.

public class IAuraGraphicsAdapter : AuraResourcePointer, IDisposable

DedicatedSystemMemory

Gets the size of dedicated system memory reserved for this adapter in bytes. This is system RAM set aside exclusively for GPU use.

public ulong DedicatedSystemMemory { get; }

Property Value

ulong

DedicatedVideoMemory

Gets the size of dedicated video memory on this adapter in bytes. This is memory physically located on the GPU.

Property Value

ulong

DeviceId

Gets the PCI device identifier that distinguishes this specific GPU model within its vendor.

public uint DeviceId { get; }

Property Value

uint

IsSoftwareAdapter

Returns true if this adapter is a software (WARP) renderer rather than a hardware-accelerated GPU.

public bool IsSoftwareAdapter { get; }

Property Value

bool

Luid

Gets the Locally Unique Identifier (LUID) for this adapter, which uniquely identifies it within the scope of the running system session.

Gets all API versions supported by this adapter, including both hardware and software variants. For only the versions usable with the current backend, see GetRelevantApiVersions(). Only populated when SetQueryFullAdapterInformation(bool) is enabled.
